tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /o rgyan rin po che rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i las byang dngos grub sprin phreng byin rlabs char 'bebs bzhugs/
༄༅/ /o rgyan rin po che rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i las byang dngos grub sprin phreng byin rlabs char 'bebs bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// o rgyan rin po che rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i las byang dngos grub sprin phreng byin rlabs char 'bebs bzhugs/

na mo pra wā ka ra ya/ 'dir gu ru rin po che rje 'bangs nyer lnga bsnyen cing bsgrub par mos pa'i gang zag skal ldan dam tshig can gyi rnal 'byor pas/ dben pa'i gnas su rten bshams pa'i drung du phyi nang gi mchod pa rnams dang*/ ga ṇa tsakra'i yo byad longs spyod la sogs pa tshar du dngar ba gtsang zhing bzang bar bshams la/ de yang las rim don tshan nyer lnga bstan pa las/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ skyabs yul rnams gsal gdab la/ na mo/ bde gshegs 'dus pa dkyil 'khor gtso// khyab bdag rgyal ba ye sangs rgyas// kun bzang pad+ma thod phreng la// bdag sogs 'gro rnams skyabs su mchi// gnyis pa sems bskyed pa/ deng nas bla med byang chub bar// mtha' klas sems can kun don du// gzhan phan phrin las rlabs chen gyis// 'khor ba dong sprug sems bskyed do// gsum pa sngon 'gro gtor ma bran la/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bh+rūṃ las rin chen gtor snod du// 'bru gsum 'od zhu 'dod yon rnams// zag med bde ba bskyed par gyur// snang zhing srid pa'i 'byung po dang*// bgegs rigs lan chags rnams la bsngo// tshim zhing dgyes nas gnod sems spong*// blta bar mi dbang log 'dren rnams// dengs shig gal te bka' 'das na// dbang chen 'bar ba'i bden stobs kyis// rdul phran bzhin du brlag ta re// oṃ sum bha ni sogs hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod/ gu gul bdug /yungs kar brab la bgegs bskrad/ bzhi pa mtshams gcod srung 'khor ni/ hrīḥ dngos kun ka dag ye rdzogs klong*// rang gsal 'dzin med mtshams bcad do// steng 'og bar mtshams ye shes kyi// me ri lnga ldan srung 'khor gyur// dharma dhā tu dzñā na pañtsa badz+ra tsa kra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐/ lnga pa mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ 'dir bshams phyi nang gsang ba'i rdzas// sman gtor rak+ta la sogs pa// bla med mchog gi mchod pa rnams// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ dzñā na pañtsa a mṛ ta/

ma hā ba ling ta/ ma hā rak+ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ sngags lan gsum brjod cing mchod rdzas rnams la bdud rtsi 'thor/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da 'i bar brjod/ de nas drug pa dngos gzhi bdag mdun dbyer med gcig char du bskyed pa'i rim pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ blo 'das brjod med de bzhin nyid kyi ngang*// stong dang snying rje zung 'jug rtsal mdangs las// rig pa'i ngo bo hūm̐ yig mthing ka shar// yongs gyur bdag nyid chen po pad+ma 'byung*// rgyal kun 'dus pa mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang*// mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku// dkar gsal zla mdog zhi 'dzum spyan gsum can// pad zhwa rgod ldem rin chen nyi zlas brgyan// phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas ka pā la// bdud rtsis bkang dbus 'chi med tshe bum 'dzin// gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ḍā ru dril chung brgyan// yid bzhin nor dang dzam bu chu gser gyi// snyan cha mgul rgyan la sogs du mas spras// zab chen dbang sngon phod ka thun mtshams kyi// 'char ka'i mdog mtshungs chos gos rnam gsum ldan// lha rdzas rin thang bral ba'i ber gyis bklubs// zhabs gnyis rdor skyil zla nyi pad+ma'i steng*// ye shes lnga ldan 'od kyi gur khang dbus// snang zhing stong la stong bzhin snang ba yi// gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur// bder gshegs zhing khams yon tan skur rdzogs shing*// sku yi bkod pas rab 'byams dkyil 'khor khyab// sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i gar gyi rol rtsed las// ngo mtshar sprul pa sna tshogs cir yang ston// 'jam dpal sku yi bka' babs rig 'dzin che// sangs rgyas ye shes nyi zla gdan du bting*// dbang chen gsung gi bka' babs grub pa'i dbang*// rgyal ba mchog dbyangs spyi bor rta skad 'tsher// yang dag thugs kyi bka' babs dge slong mchog /nam mkha'i snying po nyi ma'i zer la chibs// yon tan bdud rtsi'i bka' babs rdo rje 'dzin// dzñā na ku ma brag las bdud rtsi 'byin// phrin las rdo rje phur pa'i bka' babs gtso// ye shes mtsho rgyal brag la phur pa 'debs// bla med gsang ba'i bka' babs he ru ka

/dpal gyi ye shes ma srin las la bkol// dregs pa kun 'dul bka' babs rnal 'byor che// dpal gyi seṅge dregs pa pho nyar 'gyed// stobs ldan drag sngags bka' babs 'jig rten mig /bai ro tsa na sde brgyad bran du khol// bde gshegs 'dus pa'i bka' babs chos kyi rgyal// khri srong lde'u btsan gzhan snang zil gyis gnon// bka' babs thugs kyi sras dgu lham mer gsal// grub pa'i sar gnas grub pa yongs kyi gtso// rnal 'byor dbang phyug rig sngags 'chang rnams ni// rdo rje bdud 'joms mkha' la thogs med lding*// ye shes dbyangs can mkha' spyod gnas rnams bsgrod// sog po lha dpal lce spyang phyag gis 'dzin// sna nam ye shes mkha' la bya ltar 'phur// g.yu sgra snying po gser gyi rdo rjer sprul// dpal gyi dbang phyug phur pa gdengs tshad sgrol// shud bu dpal seng chu bo gyen du bzlog /ldan ma rtse mang mi brjed gzungs rnams thob// ka ba dpal brtsegs gzhan rgyud sa ler mkhyen// rgyal ba blo gros ro langs gser du bsgyur// khye'u chung lo tsā nam mkha'i bya rnams 'dzin// dran pa nam mkha' byang nas g.yag rgod 'gugs// 'o bran dbang phyug chu la nya ltar 'phyo// rma thog rin chen pha wang zan ltar gsol// dpal gyi rdo rje ri brag thogs med rgyu// lang gro dkon mchog thog chen mda' ltar 'phen// rgyal ba byang chub mkha' la skyil krung bzhugs// gzhan yang rig 'dzin dpa' bo ḍā ki dang*// gter chen brgya rtsa gter phran stong rtsa gnyis// lung zin skyes mchog rgya bod grub chen tshogs// yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor lha rab 'byams// chos kyi srung ma dam can rgya mtsho rnams// 'ja' zer 'od klong bkra gsal snang bar gyur// gtso 'khor kun gyi gnas gsum 'bru gsum las// 'od 'phros 'og min mkha' spyod bde chen zhing*// dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas// o rgyan rje 'bangs sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs// sprul dang yang sprul dpag med 'khor bcas rnams// mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs gshegs su gsol//

de nas bdun pa spyan drangs pa/ gter gzhung rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba'i tshig bdun gsol 'debs ni/ hūm̐/ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams// pad+ma ge sar sdong po la// ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes// pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags// 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor// khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub kyi// byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol// lan gsum dang*/ gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la// sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi bskur// bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥhrī ma ha ri ni sa rā tsa hri ya tsit+ta hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdzaḥ zhes dzab lan bdun nam gsum brjod pas byin phab/ dam tshig ye shes gnyis med du gyur par mos la/ brgyad pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba rab 'byams thugs rje can// bdag sogs sems can kun don du// brtse ba chen pos rjes dgongs la// gnas 'di nyid du brtan par bzhugs// pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ dgu pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐/ sku gsum yon tan yongs rdzogs pa// mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang chen po// rje 'bangs sprul par bcas pa la// dad mos gdung bas gus phyag 'tshal// na mo pu ru ṣ+ya hoḥ bcu pa phyi mchod 'bul ba/ oṃ/ rang snang rtsal las mchod pa'i lha mo ni// mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos ma// snang gsal dri zhal rol mo gzugs sgra dri// ro dang reg chos rnam dag phyi'i mchod pa// thugs rje'i dbyings nas brtser dgongs bzhes su gsol// mchog thun dngos grub myur stsol byin gyis rlobs// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ bar dang*/ ru pa/

shab+da/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she/ dhārma dhā tu sarba pū dza āḥhūm̐/ bcu gcig pa nang mchod 'bul ba/ āḥ rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar 'chi med bcud// rang byung bdud rtsi ra sa ya na dang*// tshe dang gal gyi rmad byung brjid ldan pa'i// dam tshig rdzas mchog ma hā ba liṃ ta// rgyu drug 'khor ba'i dug lnga ye shes lngar// bsgral ba'i dmar chen rak+ta mchod par 'bul// ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta/ ma hā ba ling+ta/ ma hā rak+ta pū dza khā hi/ bcu gnyis pa gsang ba'i mchod pa/ hūm̐/ snang ba thabs kyi he ru ka /stong pa shes rab yum dang sbyor// gsang ba bla med mchod pa 'di// bde chen bde ba'i ngang du rol// ma hā su kha pū dza ho/ bcu gsum pa de bzhin nyid mchod ni/ ho/ mchod bya mchod byed thams cad kyang*// 'dzin med ma bcos khyab gdal klong*// rang byung rang grol chen po'i dbyings// 'khor gsum dag pa'i mchod pa 'bul// dharma dhā tu dzñā na gar+bha a/ bcu bzhi pa bstod pa ni/ hrīḥ gdod nas rnam dag mtha' bral chos kyi sku// lhun grub 'dus ma byas pa longs spyod rdzogs// 'gags med thugs rje'i rnam rol sprul skur ston// sku gsum pad+ma 'byung la phyag 'tshal bstod// rang bzhin dbyings las ma g.yos rnam par 'phrul// srid pa'i duḥkha mthar byed dpa' bo che// rje 'bangs tshul gyi rnal 'byor spyod pa 'chang*// grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur rnams bstod par bgyi// bco lnga pa 'dzab bzlas dmigs rim ni/ bdag mdun thugs kar pad+ma 'dab brgyad steng*// rdo rje rtse lnga'i lte bar zla dkyil hūm̐// mtha' mar sngags phreng g.yas bskor 'od zer 'phros// 'phags mchod byin rlabs rang thim slar yang ni// 'od 'phros 'gro drug sems can sdig sgrib sbyang*// dregs can zil gnon bka' dang dam la gnas// phyi snod gzhal yas nang bcud lha skur sgyur// grag stong sngags kyi rang sgra sgrog par gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐/

de ltar yang snying ci 'grub bzla zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ āḥ hrīḥm ha ri ni saḥ ra tsa hrī yaḥ tsit+ta hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥdzaḥ spyi dril yang lhag par bzla'o// de nas bcu drug pa tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ hrīḥ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas// ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros mchod rdzas kyi// 'dzin rtog bag chags nyes skyon sbyangs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi 'phro 'du las// zag med bde chen tshogs 'khor lo// rang byung ye shes bdud rtsir spel/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ hūm̐/ 'chi med rig 'dzin grub pa'i gtso// rgyal ba rgyal ba'i myu gu rnams// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// thugs dam gnyen po bskang gyur cig /nyams dga' dam gtsang spro dga'i gnas// deng 'dir byin rlabs bcud phob la// mi rtog ye shes bskyed du gsol// ma rig dbang gis sdom gsum dang*// 'gal nyams nongs pa mthol zhing bshags// nyon mongs dug lnga'i ngar 'dzin 'di// skye med ngang du bsgral nas kyang*// kun bzang klong du bstim par mdzod// gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi/ pañtsa a mri ta la khā hi/ zhes tshogs phud phul/ de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams tshogs kyi dngos grub la gsal ba gsum ldan gyis rol nas/ bcu bdun pa lhag gtor bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐/ bka' yi 'khor du dam bcas pa'i// bka' srung rdo rje'i dam tshig can// bka' yi lhag gtor dam pa bzhes// bka' las ma 'da' dam ma g.yel// u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi/ bco brgyad pa bka'i chad tho bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐/ sngon 'das dus dang bar gyi bskal pa dang*// da lta dus gsum kun bzang pad 'byung gis// dgongs gtad smon lam dbang bskur ji lta bar// chos kyi srung ma khyed rnams rjes dgongs la// tha tshig gnyer gtad ma bsnyel gtor ma bzhes// rnal 'byor phrin las gang bcol thogs med sgrubs//

bcu dgu pa brtan skyong ni/ gangs can bstan 'gro bder skyong brtan ma rnams// sngon gyi g.yar dam ma g.yel bshal chu bzhes// dal yams mtshon 'khrugs sdang ba'i dgra la bsgyur// chos dang longs spyod rgyas pa'i sdong grogs mdzod// nyi shu pa bzod gsol ni/ ho/ zab don thugs kyi sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// ma rig dbang gis nyams chag 'gal 'khrul rnams// thog med sdig bcas gnong 'gyod drag pos bshags// byang dag tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// yig brgya brjod/ nyer gcig pa byin rlabs dbang bzhi len pa rdo rje'i tshig rkang ltar bya ba ni/ gu ru mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis// bdag cag mos pa'i bu rnams la// lus la sku yis byin gyis rlobs// ngag la gsung gis= yid la thugs kyis= /dbang bzhi bskur bar= /rgyud bzhi dag par= /lam bzhi 'byongs par= /sku bzhi thob par byin gyis rlobs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma de wa dhā ki ni kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ sngags rnams lan gsum brjod nas/ mdun bskyed 'khor rnams gtso bor thim// de nyid rang thim dbyer med par// ma bcos gnyug ma spros bral klong*// gang shar bzo med ngang du bzhag / nyer gnyis pa bdag bskyed bsdu rim ni/ bskyed pa'i lha tshogs rim bzhin rang la thim// de yang sngags phreng rdo rje hūm̐ la bsdu// dmigs med blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang*// bya rtsol bral ba'i klong du mnyam par bzhag /slar yang pad 'byung sku ru lam gyis gsal// snang grag rtog tshogs ye shes rol par shar// nyer gsum pa bsngo ba ni/ e ma ho bla med yang gsang dkyil 'khor bsgrubs la sogs// dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba ci mchis pa// smon 'brel zab mo'i mtshams sbyar 'dir brten nas// bdag gzhan tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo//

nyer bzhi pa smon lam ni/ gdod ma'i bder gshegs kun tu bzang po yi// dgongs don mtha' bral lta ba'i yang rtse mchog /rnam dag a ti'i nges lam mthar phyin nas// rten 'dir 'ja' lus chos sku mngon gyur shog / nyer lnga ba bkra shis ni me tog gi char bsnyil bzhin pas/ bkra shis gang zhig sku gsum rol pa'i klong*// thugs rje kun gsal pad 'byung nyin mor byed// 'gro drug mun sel deng 'dir bde legs kyi// snang ba dam pas rtag par bkra shis shog /bkra shis gang zhig chu zla'i gar rtsed las// rtsa gsum lha tshogs byin rlabs 'od dkar can// srid pa'i gdung sel deng 'dir bde legs kyi// dpal kun yongs 'du rnam kun bkra shis shog / ces pa'ang bslab gsum mngon mtho rtogs ldan bla ma ma ṇi'i thugs bzhed bskang phyir/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos bkod pa nongs par gyur rnams kun bzang klong du bshags shing dge bas 'gro rnams rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig /sarba maṅga lam/// /

༈ swasti/ 'dir gu ru rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i las byang la cung zad rgyas par spro ba'i skabs zur rgyan 'di ltar dang po lha bskyed la/ zhabs gnyis rdor skyil zla nyi pad steng bzhugs// de phyir bud+dha badz+ra rat+na dang*// pad+ma karma thod phreng rtsal lnga gsal// pad+ma 'byung gnas pad+ma sam+bha wa// blo ldan mchog sred pad+ma rā dza dang*// sūr+ya 'od zer shāka seng gro bo lod// seng ha sgra sgrogs la sogs rang rang gi// cha lugs ma nges sna tshogs cir yang bsgyur// ye shes lnga ldan sogs gzhung ltar dang*/ gnyis pa spyan 'dren skabs/ dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas// o rgyan chen po sku lnga mtshan brgyad dang*// rje 'bangs nyer lnga sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs// sprul dang yang sprul sogs gzhung ltar dang*/ gsum pa phyag 'tshal la/ mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang chen po// sku lnga mtshan brgyad rje 'bangs bcas// dad mos gdung bas gus phyag 'tshal// bzhi pa bstod pa'i skabs/ srid pa'i du khaḥmathar byed dpa' bo che// gang 'dul tshul gyi rnal 'byor spyod pa 'chang*// ces dang*/ lnga pa tshogs 'bul dang bskang bshags bsgral bstab kyi rim pa la/ gzhung gi tshogs byin rlabs dang sngags kyi mthar/ hūm̐/ chos dbyings mtha' bral klong yangs nas// snang stong zung 'jug bde ba che// rig rtsal ma 'gags cir yang shar// rgyal dang rgyal sras rgya mtsho rnams// 'dir gshegs tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// ga na tsakra pū dza khā hi/ ces tshogs kyi mchod pa phul la/ de nas bskang ba bya ba ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sku gsum ye rdzogs pad 'byung thod phreng rtsal// sku lnga rgyal ba dgongs brgyud thugs dam bskang*// gu ru sprul pa'i mtshan brgyad la sogs pa// rig 'dzin brda' yi brgyud pa'i thugs dam bskang*// mnga' bdag mtsho rgyal rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga*// gang zag snyan brgyud bla ma'i= mthing dmar cod pan 'chang ba bka' brgyud kyi// byin rlabs don gyi brgyud pa'i=

rat+na gling sogs gter chen gter phran bdag /mkha' 'gro gtad brgyud bla ma'i= karma chags med bka' gter yongs kyi bdag /shog ser chos spel brgyud pa'i= thugs kyi rdo rje'i dgongs gtad las can rnams// smin grol lam zab brgyud rim= 'brel tshad thar pa'i go 'phang 'god nus pa'i// skye bdun myong grol brgyud pa'i= mthong thos dran pas 'gro ba sgrol ba'i mgon// drin chen rtsa brgyud bla ma'i= mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char ltar 'bebs// yi dam rgyud sde'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*// sa lam bar chad sel zhing phrin las sgrub// chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang*// hūm̐ hrīḥ rang byung gdod nas he ru ka yi gnas// gzhal yas tshogs khang 'bar ba nyams re dga'// bkra gsal ye shes dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs// lhun re chags zhing gzi byin 'od dang ldan// phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang de kho na'i// dam rdzas mchod pa rmad byung dwangs re spro// lta sgom rnam dag spyod pa'i ngang tshul gyi// sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor mched lcam dam re gtsang*// hūm̐ hrīḥ thugs dam gnyan bskang mchod pa'i bye brag ni// mchod yon me tog bdug spos snang gsal dri// zhal zas sgra snyan 'dod yon lnga la sogs// phyi yi mchod pas thugs dam bskang gyur cig /rmad byung brjid ldan ma hā ba ling ta// 'chi med rdzas mchog pañtsa a mṛ ta// chags med chags bral ar+ghaṃ rak+ta dmar// pad+ma dung can la sogs mtshan ldan gyi// bla med nang gi mchod pas thugs dam bskang*// gzung 'dzin snang ba rang grol gnyis med ngang*// mchod bya mchod byed chos nyid dag pa'i klong*// kun bzang bde chen dbyings su bskang gyur cig / ces bskang ngo*// de nas bshags pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bla ma dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs// bdag ni skye ba thog med nas// da lta'i lus 'di yan chad du// ma rig rmongs pa'i dbang gyur pas// rtsa ba yan lag nyes ltung rnams// tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags// oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya

sogs yig brgya brjod/ de nas bsgral las ni/ hūm̐/ nga ni ye nas che ba'i mchog /dbang drag 'bar ba drag po rtsal// snang srid dregs pa sde brgyad rnams// kun kyang bka' nyan bran khol gyur// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ 'gugs pa ni/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid dpal gyi thugs ka nas// sprul pa'i khro chung skar ltar 'khrugs// bstan dgra sgos dgra log 'dren rnams// khug cig dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥphaṭa/ bsgral zhing bstab pa ni/ hūm̐/ chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las khro bo'i sku// zhing bcu tshang ba'i bstan dgra bsgral phyir du// ye shes mtshon gyis dug lnga'i phung po bcom// dag pa rnam dag bdud rtsir bsgyur byas nas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskang gyur cig / de nas tshogs la longs spyod pa sogs gzhung ltar bya'o// ces pa'ang karma chags med dngos sprul pad+ma 'chi med grub dbang gis bzhed ltar si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel ba maṅga lam/// /
